arcanist.name: Arcanist
default_dialogue: Threads of power cling to you. I can loosen some, or bind others tighter.
Embers remember every spell they touch.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
default_dialogue: Steel keeps a sharper memory than flesh.
Show me what you carry. Embers can make it lighter, or heavier.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
default_dialogue: Nothing down here is useless. Some things are just waiting for the right hand.
Buy it, use it, lose it. That's the honest bargain.
